content.comment_body: Hello, could anyone assist me? I'm trying to use the data logging feature, and I'm confident the configuration is correct. My project uses 29,800 out of 30,000 units of layout memory, while other parameters are not heavily filled. Could this high memory usage be the reason why data logging isn't functioning? I appreciate any help.
Please upload your project to the forum for review.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing issues with the data logging function not working despite proper configuration. Their project nearly reaches the maximum allowed layout memory, leading to concerns about whether memory limitations might be causing the failure. This highlights a common frustration among users regarding hidden system restrictions and lack of transparent error messaging, which can undermine confidence and hinder workflows.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the data logging feature to operate reliably when configured correctly, regardless of program size. They also anticipate transparent error messages or guidance if memory constraints affect feature performance.
